title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG AND PASSEPARTOUT ACCEPT EACH OTHER, THE ONE AS MASTER, THE OTHER AS MAN
summary_hover: Phileas Fogg, an enigmatic and precise English gentleman, hires a new French servant named Jean Passepartout to maintain his strictly regimented household.
summary_detail: Mr. Phileas Fogg is an eccentric, extremely punctual, and wealthy member of the Reform Club in London. He lives a solitary and meticulously routine life at his home in Saville Row. Having dismissed his previous servant for bringing shaving water at the wrong temperature, Fogg interviews and hires Jean Passepartout, a Frenchman seeking a quiet life. Fogg then departs for his club exactly on schedule.
